author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before was two rounded boxes with stub marks (read as 'ɔD'). Redrawn to the reference's Lucide-style brain: per hemisphere an upper and a lower r10 lobe meeting at an inward notch (6-8-10 lattice points), V notches at the fissure ends, and two asymmetric folds (upper-left rising, lower-right dropping) curling in from the side notches. Valid, gate pass.
omissions: Folds shortened to hooks (full-length folds turned each half into an '8').
